checks.evidence: verify defaults: no FAIL. finite, peak -3.79 dBFS, dc -99 dB, loop_seam PASS (wrap discontinuity 0.50x of the 99th-percentile step, spectral change 2.1 dB vs max 6), macros weight/crackle/fierceness all PASS, rebuild bit-identical. summary warnings: none.

time_shape.evidence: Loop, exactly 5.000 s, no leading/trailing silence. Crackle density 11 events/s (57 in 5 s) at default vs the brief's 5+/s; seeds 1-4 give 11, 10, 9, 13 events/s; onsets spread across the whole 5 s (0.0-4.9 s), none clustered. Crackle knob 0 still gives 5/s, so the floor meets the brief. Pop attacks 0.25-3.75 ms. Loudness steady: 400 ms windows -27.6 to -22.9 LUFS (4.8 LU spread), no decay or hole, no clicks flagged.

spectrum.evidence: Roar under 300 Hz: energy share <200 Hz 48%; 63/125/250 Hz bands -34/-31/-33 dB are the loudest steady bands in every fifth (125 Hz peak -30.2 to -32.4), 88 Hz sustained mode at -23 dB; spectrogram shows a bright 31-300 Hz band with flame-like flicker. Hiss: 8k+ band at -34 dB in all five segments (flat, 11% of energy), visible as a steady haze to 16k; flatness 0.23-0.32. 500 Hz-2 kHz is the quiet gap (-41 to -47 dB) between roar and pops, as intended. Centroid 2.45k/3.33k/2.47k is pulled up by pops and hiss, but the stated shape (low roar + crackle + hiss) holds; no movement is required for a loop.

parts.evidence: All three separately visible. Roar: dense low band under 300 Hz in the spectrogram and 48% of energy below 200 Hz. Crackles: ~57 vertical spikes from 1k to 8k across the spectrogram and in the waveform (sparse high-peak transients, crest 21.6 dB, density 11/s, onset centroids 1.4-4.6 kHz). Hiss: continuous 8k+ band at -34 dB. Macro sweeps isolate them: crackle=0 drops 2k/4k bands to -42/-39 dB and density to 5/s while the roar stays unchanged; fierceness=0 removes most of the 4k+ content (8k+ -47 dB) while the roar stays.

control_variation.evidence: 3 macros (weight, crackle, fierceness), all claims PASS: weight centroid 3.7k->3.2k->2.7k->2.3k->1.9k Hz; crackle density 5.0->7.8->11.4->15.2->18.4 events/s; fierceness -32.1->-28.5->-24.9->-22.0->-19.3 LUFS. All four stay inside the brief (>=9 events/s, roar-dominant low bands, hiss at 8k+ -34 dB, loop 5 s).

notes: fierceness 0 (-32 LUFS) takes the hiss and pops away almost entirely (centroid 696 Hz, rolloff 375 Hz), so at the bottom of the knob it is a rumble only, outside the brief; weight 0 is also very bright (centroid 3.7k).
Peak/crest: 21.6 dB crest at -24.9 LUFS is peaky for a fire loop; a few isolated spikes reach -3.8 dBFS, fine as pops but may read as too sparse and sharp.
The roar is a fairly flat band 31-300 Hz with a 125 Hz bump, no mid body between 500 Hz and 2 kHz (-41 to -47 dB); measurement cannot say whether it reads as flame or as a rumble plus ticks.
